extracted.name: Baked Salmon and Shrimp
extracted.description: Use as many shrimp or salmon as you desire. This is purely a season as you desire type dish. I have no measurements. I sprinkled until my ancestors whispered it was enough. 🤤❤🔥
ingredient_lines: Shrimp peeled and deveined (raw or cooked)
instruction_lines: Turn broiler on and place oven rack on second level from top
Place salmon skin side down on aluminum foil lined pan. Sprinkle liberally with All Purpose Seasoning and Old Bay Seasoning. Lightly coat with lemon butter sauce.
Place in oven and broil for 12 minutes. Remove and add shrimp around salmon and season the same as the salmon. Place back in oven for 5-7 minutes or until desired doneness.
